description: This PHP class 'FormatWithJobTitle' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to format entity values into job title names by fetching data via 'JobTitleService'. It resides within the OrangeHRM maintenance access strategy for formatting values based on job titles.

classes.name: FormatWithJobTitle
classes.description: A class that formats entity values into job title names using JobTitleService.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of JobTitleService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Fetches and returns the job title name for the given entity value, or null if not found.
